sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'd like to see the new migration plan without reporting.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So {S1|owner} sends me the revised plan by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'll update the plan now that reporting is out.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Please share it when it's ready.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good, I'll expect it from {S1|owner} by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The contractor will need a sponsor on our side.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S3|owner} will be their point of contact, starting {DATE_ABS|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Happy to.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The security contractor needs someone to work with.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: I can be their contact.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then {S3|owner} sponsors them from {DATE_ABS|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Customers who asked about the mobile app should hear from us.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S3|owner} drafts a message for the account managers by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Wait, did you say {DATE_REL}?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Should we explain the mobile app delay to customers?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes, they deserve an answer.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S3|owner} writes the message for account managers by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Got it, {DATE_REL}.
